理想半波片、固定检偏器；φ 包含入射偏振与轴零点。实际测量还受波长、损耗与探测器响应影响。

任务

改变波片角度，测量透射功率，得到角度—功率曲线。

body.en:
P(θ) = P₀ cos²(2θ − φ)

Ideal half-wave plate and fixed analyzer; φ includes input polarization and axis zero. Wavelength, loss and detector response affect the physical measurement.

Task

Vary the plate angle, measure transmitted power and obtain an angle–power curve.

DefineAngle origin, units and range

InterpretActual angle, power and calibration

title.zh: MHS：把不同设备接到共同能力接口
title.en: MHS: a shared capability interface for heterogeneous devices

status.zh: Anthropic × HHMI Janelia · 研究预览

body.zh:
人 / Agent / 自动化程序MCP · CLI · API
↓
共同设备接口发现设备 · 读状态 · 写控制量
激光器驱动功率、开关
转台驱动角度、位置
相机驱动曝光、图像
物理设备与各自的编程接口

定义

MHS（Model Hardware Standard）把设备包装为共同驱动接口；物理说明标签描述设备能力及操作条件。

改变了什么

上层程序按能力发现和操作仪器，型号差异由驱动承担。同一套设备能力可从不同入口访问。

在扫描中

找到能旋转波片的轴和能读取光功率的通道，再通过共同接口操作。

可继承的机制：让设备“自我描述”，让上层程序脱离厂商函数名。
body.en:
People / agents / automationMCP · CLI · API
↓
Shared device interfaceDiscover devices · Read state · Write controls
Laser driverPower, enable
Stage driverAngle, position
Camera driverExposure, image
Physical devices and their programming interfaces

Definition

MHS wraps equipment in a shared driver interface. Physical-description tags explain capabilities and operating conditions.

What changes

Callers operate named capabilities. Drivers translate them for each device; MCP, CLI and API expose the same interface.

In the scan

Find an axis that rotates the plate and a channel that measures optical power, then operate both through a common interface.

Self-describing capabilities let callers work independently of vendor function names.

title.en: Device interfaces differ in their implementation choices

status.zh: 三个 Open-MHS 独立维护；Cuntinum MHP 为另一项目
status.en: Three independently maintained Open-MHS projects; Cuntinum MHP is a separate project

body.zh:
独立项目实现的组织方式具体区别
Open-MHS · Abenor Labs能力标签 → 设备基类 → 传输驱动标签随设备提供；读写检查集中在运行层；支持生成设备说明。
Open MHS · tongriyaotxt设备注册 → 命令分派 → 运动技能在读写之上增加机器人技能，把连续动作交给本地控制。
Open MHS · SCUT-ESA共同接口 → 显式后端 → VISA 仪器分别管理实机、实验性与模拟后端；维护者列出两款 UNI-T 仪器的实机记录。
MHP · Cuntinumdiscover / read / write / execute
+ State Bus		以四类原语组织 SDK 和驱动，用共享状态组织设备协作；包名 khp。

共同点是“能力—驱动”映射；差异在状态共享、动作组织和设备后端。选择依据应落实到所需设备与操作。
body.en:
Independent projectImplementation structureConcrete distinction
Open-MHS · Abenor LabsCapability tags → device base class → transportDevice-owned tags; centralized read/write checks; generated device documentation.
Open MHS · tongriyaotxtRegistry → command dispatch → motion skillsRobot skills add local continuous control above individual reads and writes.
Open MHS · SCUT-ESACommon interface → explicit backend → VISA instrumentSeparates hardware, experimental and simulated backends; reports hardware work with two UNI-T models.
MHP · Cuntinumdiscover / read / write / execute
+ State Bus		Four primitive families organize SDKs and drivers; a shared state bus supports coordination. Package: khp.

The common mechanism is capability-to-driver mapping. State sharing, action composition and device backends distinguish the implementations.

title.zh: AIP：把一次调用变成持续可追踪的操作
title.en: AIP: track physical operations beyond a single call

status.zh: Agent–Instrument Protocol · 用户提供的 PRD v1.1

body.zh:
客户端请求read · write · ramp · act
↓

常驻仪器服务

量 / 动作 / 活动单位、参数、进度、完成条件
资源与状态touches · occupies · events
↓ ↑
型号驱动 + 通信 channel下发操作；读取实际状态

定义

AIP（Agent–Instrument Protocol）把仪器连接、长活动与执行记录放进持续运行的服务；客户端提交工作并查询结果。

关键区别

“动作已受理”与“物理目标已达成”分别记录。资源声明描述操作会影响什么；读数区分仪器报告、驱动记账与推断。

在扫描中

转台移动期间，服务持续跟踪到位条件；调用者离开后，活动和观测仍有明确身份。

可继承的机制：由运行服务持有操作生命周期，供不同调用者持续查询和使用。
body.en:
Client requestread · write · ramp · act
↓

Persistent instrument service

Quantity / action / activityUnits, parameters, progress, completion
Resources and statetouches · occupies · events
↓ ↑
Model driver + communication channelIssue operations; read actual state

Definition

AIP places device connections, long-running activities and execution records in a persistent service. Clients submit work and retrieve results.

Key distinction

Acceptance and physical achievement are recorded separately. Resource declarations describe effects; readings distinguish device reports, tracked values and inference.

In the scan

The service tracks arrival while the stage moves. Activities and observations retain identities beyond the initiating call.

Mechanism to carry forward: the runtime owns the physical operation’s lifecycle across individual tool calls.

title.zh: OpenMHP：让设备说明、驱动与运行记录相互关联
title.en: OpenMHP: connect descriptions, drivers and run records

status.zh: 公开规范草案与 Python 实现
status.en: Public draft specification and Python implementation

body.zh:
DEVICE.md身份、摘要、操作说明
descriptor.yamlsignals · settings · actions
driver.py读写与动作的设备实现
references / scripts / methods知识材料、过程脚本与方法参数

定义

OpenMHP 用设备包把操作说明、机器可读描述与驱动放在一起，再以统一请求操作设备。

执行路径

device/describe → 选择能力 → 读取 / 写入 / 调用动作 → 查询任务和运行文件

关键区别

描述按需加载；长动作交给任务；过程脚本与产出的文件关联到 run。参考设备包主要经过孪生测试。

可继承的机制：一个可分发的设备包，把“怎么理解、怎么运行、产出在哪里”连在一起。
body.en:
DEVICE.mdIdentity, summary and instructions
descriptor.yamlsignals · settings · actions
driver.pyDevice implementation of reads, writes and actions
references / scripts / methodsReferences, procedures and method parameters

Definition

OpenMHP packages instructions, machine-readable descriptions and drivers, then exposes devices through common requests.

Execution path

device/describe → select capabilities → read / write / invoke → inspect jobs and run files

Key distinction

Descriptions load on demand; jobs handle long actions; runs associate scripts with output files. Reference device packages are primarily twin-tested.

Mechanism to carry forward: a distributable device package connecting understanding, execution and outputs.

title.zh: LAP：把资源占用和测量含义写进任务契约
title.en: LAP: include reservations and measurement meaning in task contracts

status.zh: Shiyanjia Lab · LAP v0.1 设计论文
status.en: Shiyanjia Lab · LAP v0.1 design paper

body.zh:
InstrumentCard能力、设备身份与物理限制
↓
Reservation + task设备 / 样品占用，任务状态与参数绑定的执行确认
↓
MeasurementResult数值、单位、校准、不确定度与来源

定义

LAP（Lab Agent Protocol）沿用 Agent 之间发现和任务协作的结构，把仪器作为有物理状态和测量结果的参与者。

在扫描中

取得转台与探测器的使用权；提交扫描任务；返回带角度单位、探测器校准信息及测量来源的结果。

可继承的机制：让“结果是什么、在什么条件下产生”成为任务契约的一部分。
body.en:
InstrumentCardCapabilities, identity and physical limits
↓
Reservation + taskDevice/sample reservation, task state and task-bound confirmation
↓
MeasurementResultValues, units, calibration, uncertainty and provenance

Definition

LAP retains agent discovery and task collaboration while treating instruments as participants with physical state and measurement results.

In the scan

Reserve the stage and detector, submit a scan task, and return results with angle units, detector calibration and measurement provenance.

Mechanism to carry forward: make the meaning and conditions of a measurement part of the task contract.

title.zh: OAHL：把分散的设备组织成可访问的资源
title.en: OAHL: make distributed devices accessible resources

status.zh: MIT · 节点、SDK 与传输插件
status.en: MIT · Nodes, SDKs and transport plugins

body.zh:
调用者JavaScript / Python SDK
↓
本地节点 / 可选注册与中继发现能力与节点地址
↓
会话管理 → 设备适配器 → 传输Serial · ADB · MQTT · TCP
节点所在位置的真实设备

定义

OAHL（Open Agent Hardware Layer）把设备暴露为节点中的能力，调用者通过会话取得使用权，再由适配器和传输插件执行。

它重点解决什么

设备在哪里、通过哪个节点访问、当前由谁使用。README 展示了通过 ADB 操作手机的路径。

discover找到设备
reserve取得会话
execute执行能力
release释放占用
body.en:
CallerJavaScript / Python SDK
↓
Local node / optional registry and relayFind capabilities and node addresses
↓
Session → adapter → transportSerial · ADB · MQTT · TCP
Physical equipment attached to the node

Definition

OAHL exposes capabilities through hardware nodes. Callers reserve sessions; adapters and transport plugins perform the operation.

Primary problem

Where equipment is, which node exposes it and who is using it. The README demonstrates an Android device through ADB.

discoverFind equipment
reserveAcquire a session
executeRun a capability
releaseRelease the resource

title.zh: 三个岛屿，分别承担同一次操作的不同责任
title.en: Three mechanism families serve the same physical operation

status.zh: 偏振扫描 · 机制组合

body.zh:
C

取得可用设备

按旋转轴与功率测量能力找到设备，建立会话，确认资源占用。

设备身份 + 可访问端点
A

建立操作的共同含义

把转台位置定义为半波片角度 θ；把探测器通道定义为光功率 P。

能力 + 单位 + 轴零点
B

执行并保存物理结果

每点设角、确认到位、采集功率；将实际读数与同一次 run 关联。

run → observations

IOP 的连接点是共同的操作身份：设备描述、执行请求、实际观测和方法知识，始终指向同一件事。
body.en:
C

Acquire available equipment

Find rotational and power-measurement capabilities, establish a session and reserve resources.

identity + endpoint
A

Establish shared operation meanings

Define the stage position as plate angle θ and the detector channel as optical power P.

capability + unit + origin
B

Execute and retain physical results

Set each angle, confirm arrival and acquire power; associate actual readings with the same run.

run → observations

IOP joins these mechanisms through shared operation identities: descriptions, requests, observations and methods refer to the same operation.

title.zh: 共同语义可以复用已有设备标准
title.en: Shared semantics can build on existing device standards

body.zh:
既有基础它已经提供的对象IOP 可映射的部分

共享操作模型；入口选择由使用场景决定。

Existing foundationObjects it already providesWhat IOP can map

Share the operation model; choose an interface for the use case.

title.zh: IOP：以操作为中心，把知识、执行和观测连成整体
title.en: IOP: connect knowledge, execution and observations around operations

IOP 的核心约束

一次操作必须能从“它的物理含义”追到“这次如何执行”，再追到“结果由哪些观测支持”。原理与经验通过操作身份关联；方法复用这些操作；驱动实现它们。
body.en:
InstrumentPhysical identity, capabilities and resources
provides
OperationInputs, effects, completion and outputs
composes into
MethodApplicability, procedure and analysis
Driver binding ↓Each invocation creates ↓Specifies acquisition ↓
BindingVendor commands and control systems
executes
RunParameters, reservations, state and events
produces
ObservationReadback, units, time and conditions
The central IOP contract

An operation must connect its physical meaning to a particular execution and the observations supporting its result. Principles and practical knowledge link to operation identities; methods compose operations; drivers implement them.

title.zh: 一个操作定义，供人理解，也供程序执行
title.en: One operation definition for people and software

body.zh:
人看到的操作定义

偏振扫描

沿给定角度序列旋转半波片，每点确认转台到位后采集透射功率。

角度
单位为度；零点对应波片轴的标定位置。
功率
单位为瓦；记录工作波长与探测器校准引用。
输出
保存实际角度、功率与采集时间，形成同一份扫描记录。
程序读取的同一份定义
id: optics.polarization_scan
version: 0.1
requires:
  angle: {unit: deg, origin: plate_axis_zero}
  power: {unit: W}
context: [wavelength, calibration_ref]
inputs: {angles: {type: array, unit: deg}}
procedure:
  for_each: {angle_target: angles}
  steps:
    - move_to: angle_target
    - wait_for: stage_settled
    - read: [angle_actual, power, time]
result: {columns: [angle_actual, power, time]}

原理、说明、参数与程序共享同一个 id 和版本；修改方法时，同时更新它们的对应关系。
body.en:
Human-readable operation

Polarization scan

Rotate the half-wave plate through the requested angles. At each point, confirm stage settling before acquiring transmitted power.

Angle
Degrees relative to the calibrated plate-axis origin.
Power
Watts, with wavelength and a detector calibration reference.
Output
Actual angle, power and acquisition time in one scan record.
The same definition for software
id: optics.polarization_scan
version: 0.1
requires:
  angle: {unit: deg, origin: plate_axis_zero}
  power: {unit: W}
context: [wavelength, calibration_ref]
inputs: {angles: {type: array, unit: deg}}
procedure:
  for_each: {angle_target: angles}
  steps:
    - move_to: angle_target
    - wait_for: stage_settled
    - read: [angle_actual, power, time]
result: {columns: [angle_actual, power, time]}

Principles, instructions, parameters and execution share one id and version. Method changes update their relationships together.

title.zh: 一次执行，必须走到实际状态和测量读回
title.en: Follow execution through to physical state and readback

完成条件来自仪器行为

驱动给出到位状态或读回判据；方法定义需要满足的条件，然后才采集功率。

中断后根据读回恢复认知

连接中断时保留 run。重连后先检查位置与活动状态，再决定继续、结束或保留未完成记录。

执行记录回答“发出了什么”；观测记录回答“物理上发生了什么”。IOP 用同一个 run 将两者关联。

Detector acquisition complete

Completion follows device behavior

The driver supplies a settled state or readback criterion. The method specifies the required condition before power acquisition.

Reconcile from readback after interruption

Retain the run across disconnection. Read position and activity state on reconnection before continuing, ending or retaining a partial record.

Execution records state what was issued; observations state what physically occurred. A shared run links both.
